keyEvents.text: First Half ends, Atletico Madrid 0, Bayern Munich 0.
Second Half begins Atletico Madrid 0, Bayern Munich 0.
Goal! Atletico Madrid 0, Bayern Munich 1. Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal.
Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Atletico Madrid. Lee Kang-In replaces Álex Baena.
Substitution, Atletico Madrid. Koke replaces Robin Le Normand.
Substitution, Atletico Madrid. Ademola Lookman replaces Alexander Sørloth.
Substitution, Bayern Munich. Nathaniel Brown replaces Lennart Karl.
Goal! Atletico Madrid 0, Bayern Munich 2. Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) right footed shot from a difficult angle on the right to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Harry Kane.
Substitution, Atletico Madrid. Rodrigo Mendoza replaces Pablo Barrios.
Substitution, Atletico Madrid. Jonathan David replaces Julián Alvarez.
Substitution, Bayern Munich. Kim Min-Jae replaces Alphonso Davies.
Giuliano Simeone (Atletico Madrid) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
